definitions.explanation: Small in number, and so precious or notable. Usually placed before the noun: {数少|かずすく}ない{友人|ゆうじん} (one of my few friends).

examples.japanese: {数少|かずすく}ない⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{数少|かずすく}ない⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧だ。
examples.english: He is one of my few friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}っている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧{数少|かずすく}ない{和菓子屋|わがしや}だ。
examples.english: This shop is one of the few Japanese sweet shops that still keep to the traditional methods.

notes:
⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧ (number) + ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ (few). Unlike ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧, it is mostly used before a noun, and often in 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ / 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧ (one of the few …).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数少|かずすく}ない〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧: one of the few …
- ⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧{数少|かずすく}ない: few remaining

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: few, little, the everyday word, mostly used as a predicate
- ⟦{数多|かずおお}い→数多い：32228_kazuooi⟧: numerous, many, the opposite
- ⟦{希少|きしょう}→希少：12444_kishou⟧: rare, scarce, more formal
